Appearance

Tall and imposing, long dark hair in a severe style. Sharp angular features and piercing gray eyes. Dresses in practical but fine dark clothing. Silver pendant at her throat.

What We Know

Mayor of Stonehaven, elected six months ago after the previous mayor died in Blackwood Forest. Ordered the town gates sealed, citing escalating threats. Authoritative and enigmatic — speaks in careful, measured tones.

First Impressions

Commands respect through sheer force of will. Clearly carrying a heavy burden.
